shared_elements: carved stone surface in shallow relief
incised linear motifs on weathered rock
arrangement of motifs in stacked horizontal tiers or bands
justification: Both are weathered stone surfaces bearing shallow incised carving arranged in stacked horizontal tiers, and both include rounded disc-like elements among the motifs, which is about the extent of the correspondence. The decisive difference is that A is a flat architectural wall covered edge to edge with dense rows of small repeated sign-like glyphs, while B is a three-dimensional freestanding sculpted figure whose few large, curvilinear motifs are laid out symmetrically over a modelled body.
